posts.zh:
dsh-plugin-msg-nav 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。对话节点导航条：对话区右缘一列短横线节点对应每条用户消息，支持阅读位置跟踪、悬停预览卡片、点击跳转高亮、滑动窗口与自动隐藏。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-394feeb06b1da1700056.html
posts.en:
dsh-plugin-msg-nav is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Conversation node navigation rail for the DSH Web UI: one dash per user message on the right edge, reading-position tracking, hover preview card, click-to-jump with highlight line, sliding window, and auto-hide.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-394feeb06b1da1700056.html
